name: North Noir
description:
North Noir turns your own footage into a finished video with animated motion graphics, driven entirely from the conversation.

You can use North Noir to:

Upload a talking-head or presenter video and have North Noir transcribe the speech, plan timed graphics (lower-thirds, stat cards, callouts, or full-screen cutaways), and export a composited final video.

Generate a standalone motion-graphics clip from a text prompt, in one of several visual styles.

Track render progress and jump into the live North Noir Studio project to preview or request changes to a specific graphic before final export.

Every graphic is authored as animation code and rendered deterministically, your original footage and audio are never altered or regenerated. Every job runs against your own North Noir account and token balance via secure OAuth.

_published_faq.name: How do I add North Noir to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add North Noir to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-claude.northnoir.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the North Noir MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: North Noir provides these MCP tools: add_motion_graphics_to_video, adjust_project_graphic, confirm_motion_graphics, create_motion_graphics_clip, create_video_upload, export_project, get_job, get_upload_status, inspect_project, list_jobs, list_motion_graphics_options, and stop_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to North Noir?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to North Noir in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.

_published_faq.name: Does North Noir MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: North Noir requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
North Noir is developed by North Noir. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
